title: Conditional κ = 0.003643180671645 (+2.21652614e-7 over #7140): temporal chart-120 split
body:

Pivot 648 retires there; two explicit owned buffers and one paid rank-seven path split into ranks four and three complete the construction. The productive rank-nine helper splits into ranks five and four. Ali Romman supplied the mechanism, and ToikY's earlier chart-120 lead remains credited.

The native word adds **21 ADDs, two SCALEs, one MOVE, two INITs and two CLEARs**. Owned inventory changes from 53 labels/56 lifetimes/peak 44 to **55/58/44**. The unchanged 17-stage caller has **110,434 paid positions**, **22,342 productive fields**, surplus 1,424, zero empty credit, ordinary source-unit work **779,260,044 < 10⁹**, and precision **c=2362** on the freshly derived **1125/F25** grid. All added storage, scalar, routing and compiler services are charged.

All three direct CPython 3.14.7 commands and the registered isolated CPython 3.12.16 replay passed, matching every frozen receipt field. All 24 scientific hashes remained unchanged. Coverage includes the exact timed certificate; whole arbitrary-input forward/adjoint; COPY and exact lifecycle checks; 18 native corruption controls; six sets of 512 chart/phase columns; finite physical routes; all **3,038 paid/helper maps and 104 main boundaries**; both directed prices; fresh owned-stock, ordinary, precision and fixed-tape costs; and **54 strict + 4 functional outer conditions**.
